name: Basalt Dev Portfolio Site
description: A polished developer portfolio built around clear project proof, a dark basalt palette, and restrained cyan beam details. Made for developers who need an editable site that presents their work with confidence.
whatYouGet: A complete responsive portfolio page with navigation, hero, project work, and footer.
Project descriptions structured around the problem, contribution, stack, and outcome.
A cohesive dark-zinc and cyan visual system with subtle, accessible motion.
Editable HTML or a requested React, Vue, or Tailwind implementation.
goodFit: Developers applying for roles who need their strongest work to scan quickly.
Indie hackers and app developers presenting shipped products or technical case studies.
notFor: A generic agency site or product sales page.
A portfolio that needs fabricated credentials or testimonials.
requiredInputs: Name, role, short bio, and a working contact destination.
Project details, including the developer's contribution and any verified outcomes.

faq.q: Can I use this for a multi-page portfolio?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the shared navigation and visual system consistent, and give each requested page a clear purpose and active navigation state.

faq.q: What if I do not have measured project outcomes?
faq.a: Describe what changed or shipped without inventing numbers. A concrete contribution and honest context are stronger than unsupported metrics.

faq.q: Can the style be adapted to an existing brand?
faq.a: Yes. Preserve the basalt structure and restrained beam motif while adjusting the accent and details to match supplied brand requirements.

demoPrompt: /sl-basalt-dev-portfolio-site Build a responsive portfolio for fictional full-stack developer Rowan Vale, aimed at prospective product teams. In order, show a split hero, three proof stats, three selected projects, a work philosophy section, three contribution areas, two collaborator quotes, then a contact CTA and linked footer. Quote “I build useful software with a clear point of view.” and end with “Have a useful problem to solve?” and “Start a conversation”. Use dark basalt and cyan beams.
followUpPrompts: Make the project summaries more concise while keeping each contribution and outcome clear.
Port the page to React and preserve responsive behavior, accessible focus states, and reduced motion.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
